discrepancies.reconciliation: Report HRP, Minimum Variance, and ERC simultaneously across multi-objective metrics (realized vol, return, Sharpe, max drawdown, diversification ratio, concentration, Euler reconciliation). Report OBJECTIVE_WINNER for each optimization objective.

discrepancies.reconciliation: Evaluate Historical Simulation, Parametric Gaussian, and Cornish-Fisher across 5 seeds. Report full calibration diagnostics (exceptions, expected exceptions, coverage deviation, Kupiec LR, Kupiec p-value, 99% VaR, 99% ES) without claiming a single scalar winner.
